items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I just fell in love with Baby White. I thought she -- she just charmed me when she sang, 'You're my Thrill.'

ctx.x: Some of the Charlie -- what were some of the (inaudible).

Billie Holliday was not a particular favorite singer of mine. I liked, in those days for jazz singing, Ella Fitzgerald and I liked Anna Robinson and for ballad singing, oh, I just fell in love with Baby White. I thought she -- she just charmed me when she sang, 'You're my Thrill.'
